title: Run KRunner runners out-of-process so they can't take down Plasmashell if and when they crash
line: A search plugin that crashed Plasma once now runs in its own process, so it can no longer take down the panels and desktop.
explanation: C++ KRunner plugins are loaded into the process that searches (plasmashell for Kickoff/Kicker, krunner), so a buggy third-party plugin like the reporter's krunner_recoll crashes Plasma on every search. KRunner now records, in a small memory-mapped file per process, which runner the crashing thread was loading, matching or running (a crash-signal handler that hands over to KCrash afterwards). When the process restarts, that runner is loaded through a new helper, krunner-runnerhost, which runs the plugin in its own process and offers it over the existing org.kde.krunner1 D-Bus runner interface, so later crashes only kill the helper; the plugin goes back in-process once its file is updated.

commits.message:
runnermanager: run C++ runners that crashed in a separate process

A crashing C++ runner plugin takes down whatever loaded it, plasmashell
included, again on every search. KRunner now remembers which runner
crashed the process and then runs it in krunner-runnerhost over D-Bus.

BUG: 503880

media.caption: Pure master with a third-party test runner that crashes on "crash": typing it in Kickoff takes down plasmashell (panels vanish) and it restarts, every time.

After that runner crashed Plasma once: it now runs in krunner-runnerhost. "hello" still shows its result, "crash" only kills the helper and Kickoff keeps showing the other results; plasmashell keeps the same PID.
The test runner's result while loaded inside plasmashell.
The same runner in the next search session: the helper was restarted and its result shows next to the in-process runners.
